summary.text: Reid Beaman is the Democratic candidate for the South Carolina House of Representatives, District 87, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a comic book artist and listed infrastructure, small businesses and workers' rights, and lower tax burdens among his campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Reid Beaman graduated from Edgecombe Early College High School and earned a bachelor's degree from East Carolina University in 2012.
Ballotpedia lists his profession as artist, and in a Ballotpedia survey he described himself as a "simple southern comic book artist."
In the survey, Beaman listed three messages: an approach to improving infrastructure, supporting small businesses and protecting workers' rights, and lowering the tax burden on families.
He said he is most passionate about making life affordable for South Carolinians.
